scenario: A loading dock privacy lane should close only after the incident ticket, device note, firmware advisory, operator follow-up, and previous alarm note still point to the privacy restore lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the loading dock privacy review for incident DI-1640. Start from the incident ticket, rebuild the supporting trail it references, and only take the approved close step if the privacy restore lane still lines up.

smarthome_device_incident_tickets.body_text: Device incident DI-1640: the loading dock camera stayed exposed after a vendor unload. Review device note DN-1640, firmware advisory ADV-1640, operator follow-up OPM-1640, and previous alarm note PAN-1640. If the unload is closed and the restore trail still aligns, the approved close step is to restore privacy_mode to on.

smarthome_device_notes.body_text: Device note DN-1640: cam-loading-dock-40 should return to privacy mode once the temporary unload window closes.

smarthome_firmware_advisory_texts.body_text: Firmware advisory ADV-1640: cam-loading-dock-40 is on an approved build and supports restoring privacy_mode to on after the unload window ends.

smarthome_operator_followup_messages.body_text: Operator follow-up OPM-1640: the vendor unload closed at 20:12 and no further visual verification is pending for the loading dock camera.

smarthome_previous_alarm_notes.body_text: Previous alarm note PAN-1640: the loading dock camera left privacy mode only for the unload interval and should return to privacy once the interval closes.
